SELECT HOUR(create_time) AS hour, DAYOFWEEK(create_time) - 1 AS weekday, IFNULL(dominant_emotion, '平静') AS emotion, COUNT(*) AS cnt, ROUND(AVG(mood_score), 1) AS avgScore FROM emotion_diary WHERE deleted_flag = 0 AND create_time >= #{start} GROUP BY HOUR(create_time), DAYOFWEEK(create_time) - 1, IFNULL(dominant_emotion, '平静')

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(IFNULL(diary_date, DATE(create_time)), '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, IFNULL(dominant_emotion, '平静') AS emotion, COUNT(*) AS cnt, ROUND(AVG(mood_score), 1) AS avgScore FROM emotion_diary WHERE deleted_flag = 0 AND IFNULL(diary_date, DATE(create_time)) >= #{startDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(IFNULL(diary_date, DATE(create_time)), '%Y-%m-%d'), IFNULL(dominant_emotion, '平静') ORDER BY date

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE(create_time), '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS sessionCount, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS userCount FROM consultation_session WHERE deleted_flag = 0 AND create_time >= #{start} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(DATE(create_time), '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date

SELECT IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(dur), 1), 0) FROM ( SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, s.started_at, IFNULL((SELECT MAX(m.create_time) FROM consultation_message m WHERE m.session_id = s.id), s.started_at)) AS dur FROM consultation_session s WHERE s.deleted_flag = 0 AND s.started_at IS NOT NULL ) t

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(IFNULL(diary_date, DATE(create_time)), '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS cnt FROM emotion_diary WHERE deleted_flag = 0 AND IFNULL(diary_date, DATE(create_time)) >= #{startDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(IFNULL(diary_date, DATE(create_time)), '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date
